scope: one isolated online build of the existing WBO pin, then runs of its saved artifact (approved 2026-09-30)

base.resolution: once, by ato __source-oci-acquire-base; the root digest is frozen before the build
base.endpoint_change: 2026-09-30: blob endpoint replaced by the exact host production.cloudfront.docker.com observed in run 1 (user-approved; no wildcard). Any other unlisted redirect stops the phase.
base.reuse: runs after run 2 reuse the base archive frozen in run 2 (root sha256:ebfe2f90...); no second acquisition

build_egress.max_transfer_bytes: 524288000 minus the bytes the base acquisition moved
build_egress.path: RUN steps -> session bridge -> veth -> egress gate (CONNECT only); preflight must show direct dials blocked, unlisted CONNECT 403, listed CONNECT 200 before the build

limits.archive_bound_change: 2026-09-30: raised from 128 MiB to 512 MiB after run 2 built a 372,919,274-byte image (user decision); portable bundles may now reach 768 MiB. Hosted import keeps its own limits and is out of scope.

inputs.cache: none kept; the session disk is deleted with the session

contract.K: the authored route's K: GET / on app.http = 200 (typed K only)
contract.note: D and E below are functional checks outside K; GET / = 200 is never a functional success

results_reported_separately.A_image_build: ato __source-oci-build exits 0 with a verified archive <= 512 MiB, oci.working_dir /opt/app and [[state]] server_data; any failure is its typed code (e.g. source_oci_egress_bound, source_oci_build_failed, source_oci_artifact_bounds)
results_reported_separately.B_container_start: ato app start reaches an active Run on an offline private store, without adding capabilities, root or network; the image's setcap on node gives nothing under cap-drop ALL + no-new-privileges, so an exec or bind failure is a typed start failure and the run stops there
results_reported_separately.C_fresh_receipt: the Run's receipt has fully_satisfied = true for the K above
results_reported_separately.D_client_reflection: two headless Chrome clients open /boards/ato-wbo-check; client A draws one pencil line with id ato-wbo-probe-1 through WBO's own client API; client B renders an element with that id within 10 s, and it was absent before
results_reported_separately.E_state_after_restart: after ato app stop and ato app start of the same Instance, a fresh client renders ato-wbo-probe-1 within 10 s, and the Instance's state directory holds a board file containing ato-wbo-probe-1

identity.origin: the Adapter's --user is the host owner of the state directory (run user uid 1000 on this host); it coincides with the image USER 1000:1000 here and is not a portable guarantee
identity.on_mismatch: stop and report; never run as root or chmod the state broadly

cleanup_checks: no session root, cgroup, mount or loop device left after the build
no host iptables rule tagged ato-source-oci-egress-* and no asoh* veth left
private runtime store: 0 containers and 0 volumes (anonymous volumes included) after stop
not_done: no deploy, no remote migration, no model call, #1421 untouched
coverage-50 and earlier receipts are not rewritten
existing evidence under ~/ato-d2 and host-wide Docker data are not pruned
